title: ANDS Studio — guided ANDS journey plus eCTD dossier workspace
walkthrough:
You land on a page with a top bar branded "ANDS Studio" and the tagline "file a drug like a story", plus chips for "Help", "My dossiers", and "Portfolio". The hero headline reads "File a drug with Health Canada, like telling a story." Below it, a paragraph says the tool walks you through an Abbreviated New Drug Submission step by step, "explaining every term, branching you onto the right path, and showing your submission take shape in 3D until it's ready to send. No regulatory background needed." You click "Start my submission →" (or the link "Or open your dossiers — every product in submission →"). Fine print notes "Grounded in real Health Canada process · your progress is saved automatically".

Starting a submission opens a three-column screen: a left rail titled "Your filing journey" listing steps — the current one marked "You're here", completed ones "Done", later ones locked with a padlock and a reason; a central step card; and a right panel with a 3D "submission tower" and a readiness card. The top bar now shows a status chip: "Ready to file" or a percentage like "62% ready", plus a "Start over" button.

The "My dossiers" page ("ANDS Studio · dossier manager") is headed "Your product dossiers" with a "New dossier +" button. The create form has fields "Dossier ID" (placeholder "e123456") and "Product name" (placeholder "Drugazole 10 mg tablet"). You must know the Health Canada ID format: entering anything else shows "Dossier ID must be one letter + 6–7 digits (e.g. e123456)". A note explains Health Canada issues the ID via a REP/CESG request, with a "No ID yet? Start with a placeholder →" link that generates a d-prefixed draft ID; tiles for those show a "draft ID — set real ✎" badge. Clicking "Create & open →" opens the dossier. With no dossiers, you see "No dossiers yet. Create one to start building a submission."

Inside a dossier, the top bar shows tabs M1–M5 plus chips "Application Viewer", "Audit", "Portfolio", "Journey". The layout is a section tree (each section badged "req" or "opt"), a central panel with tabs "⬆ Upload", "✦ Author in-app", and "⊘ Mark N/A" (authoring offers "💬 Draft with AI" and "✦ Sample & edit"), and a right column showing the tower, module progress ("required sections complete"), filing flags "Documents", "Fee", "Valid eCTD", plus sequence, validation, and collaboration cards.
